function local() {
  let narrow: string | number = 'local';
  const arrow = (argument: typeof narrow) => argument;
  const expression = function(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; };
  const object = {method(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; }};
  const klass = class {method(argument: typeof narrow) { return argument; }};
  arrow(1);
  expression(1);
  object.method(1);
  new klass().method(1);
}
